_comment: THE USER'S SEED-9 COMBO OFF FAILURE (2026-09-10). Their history, turn by turn: T1 land
Conservatory; T2 land Kitchen + Wild Growth on the Conservatory; T3 land Conservatory +
Overgrowth on the Kitchen; T4 land Mariposa Military Base, cast Cloud of Faeries and Emiel the
Blessed -- then clicked 'blink Cloud of Faeries x60 -- COMBO OFF [WISH-DRAW]' and got
'the loop ran; the kill did not land.'
THE ARITHMETIC SAYS IT CANNOT WIN, and that is the finding. Four lands: Kitchen 1+2 (Overgrowth)
= 3, Conservatory 1+1 (Wild Growth) = 2, Conservatory 1, Mariposa 1 -- seven mana a full tap.
Cloud of Faeries untaps TWO, Emiel's blink costs {3}, and the {C}-starved promotion has to spend
one of those two slots on Mariposa (the only colourless), so a pass refunds Kitchen 3 + Mariposa
1 = 4 against a cost of 3: NET +1, and one {C}. At the engine's 60-iteration ceiling that is 60
mana and 60 pips in TOTAL -- while the Living Wish is still in the library at ~5-6 mana a draw,
the wish and the finisher cost 4 more, and the deck-out then wants ~49 activations at {1}{C}.
It is short several times over. The user's own read agrees: 'I was later able to Combo off' --
later, on more lands.
So the button must NOT appear here. What made it appear was rule WISH-DRAW accepting 'net > 0'
as the user's 'infinite mana': a loop capped at 60 iterations netting ONE is not unbounded mana,
it is sixty mana. MTG_COMBO_OFF_BANKABLE adds exactly that arithmetic and nothing else.
DISCRIMINATING: edf_co_1 is the same shape with an Overgrowth'd Kitchen at yield 5 (net 3) and a
finisher already deployed, and it still fires. This fixture is not 'the rules got stricter', it
is 'the rules learned to count'.
_library_comment: A Living Wish ten cards down is what makes this fixture REPRODUCE rather than merely pass.
Rule WISH-DRAW's W counts a wish still in the library (the draw engine can go and get it), and
the go-off COUNT is sized by ScanHandSinks' library route, which only scans the top 20. With a
filler-only library the button is absent for the WRONG reason -- no wish at all -- and the
